resources.string: Shows that your Wavr Core is running on this device, and lets you stop it.
A setting was changed that Wavr cannot apply while it is running. Open Wavr and choose Restart to apply it. Until then, the Core on this device is not sensing.

This phone is the brain of your Wavr setup. It keeps sensing and answering your other devices while the screen is off, which is why it stays in this list.

%1$s

Nothing is sent to the internet. Tap Stop to shut the Core down — it will stay off until you start it again.
Reachable only on this device (port %1$d). Nothing on your network can connect to it.
Reachable on your Wi-Fi over HTTPS (port %1$d), by paired devices only.
The phone is running hot, so Wavr has switched its camera off for now. Everything else keeps working, and the camera comes back when it cools down.
The phone is warm, so Wavr has slowed its camera down to use less power. Everything else is unaffected.
Wavr shows one permanent notice while the Core is running, so you always know it is on and can stop it in one tap. Without notification permission it keeps running, but that notice is hidden.
